summary: Practise IFRS S1 and S2 materiality, climate-risk, emissions, and controls workflows. Explore the five-day ISSB implementation course.
lede: ISSB implementation training helps finance, sustainability, risk and audit professionals turn IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 requirements into reporting workflows. Participants practise assessing materiality, documenting climate risks, validating emissions and sustainability data, and preparing traceable evidence for review. The course also covers financed-emissions analysis and governance controls, helping teams coordinate the information, review and approval needed for disclosures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, govern, or communicate ISSB-aligned sustainability disclosures and need practical reporting workflows.
modules: IFRS S1 and S2 Reporting Foundations
IFRS S1 Governance and Data Controls
IFRS Taxonomy and Digital Data Controls
prerequisites: Working familiarity with financial reporting, sustainability reporting, risk management, or ESG data is recommended. You do not need programming skills; spreadsheet exercises use Excel, so access to a spreadsheet application is useful.
